authorization: Continue the existing baseline to 24M completion tokens per run; retain 6M, 12M and 24M results; do not restart training from the base model.
launch_scope: A seed 17 continuation only; other arms and seeds are not queued
checkpoint_policy: First complete optimizer update at or above each cumulative milestone; preserve full checkpoint outside rolling-checkpoint rotation and report actual tokens and overshoot.
evaluation_policy: Retain completed 6M evaluation; after training, evaluate saved 12M and 24M policies with the unchanged greedy MATH500/GSM8K evaluator. No test-based stopping or checkpoint selection.
rng_limitation: Python, NumPy, torch CPU and CUDA RNG states are restored. The original checkpoint does not contain the separate vLLM engine RNG stream; its seed-0 engine restarts. This is checkpoint continuation, not a claim of bitwise equivalence to an uninterrupted run.
